gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.
'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.
'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
